title: Danseuses
identity: Robert Planel's Suite Romantique no. 2, Danseuses, is an alto saxophone and piano piece, Leduc AL20247.

evidence.claim: Publisher's distributor listing identifies the piece as no. 2 of six, for alto saxophone and piano; it gives a five-part form and describes the main theme returning at the end.
An opened library catalog identifies the six-piece alto saxophone/piano suite, Leduc, 1944.

The Philharmonie de Paris ten-year saxophone guide describes no. 2, Danseuses, as light and animated in 2/4, quarter note = 96, with varied articulation and frequent tempo changes; listed duration 2:30. This is a guide description, not direct score inspection.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, Dix ans avec le saxophone

review_focus: Inference from the guide’s description: review the documented tempo/form contrast and articulation details in the score; no notation was inspected.
collection_flag: A work from an original six-piece saxophone/piano suite. A distributor calls this piece intermediate; that rating is not a SaxoBrain level.
gaps: No college performance or teaching placement verified.
No score preview or performance was inspected; the guide’s description is secondary repertoire context, not notation evidence.
